analysis.title: Blue Tsunami
key_insights: Democrats won both chambers in the midterms. Projected seats per CNN: House 231 D to 139 R, Senate 54 D to 44 R. This replaces unified Republican government with divided government under a Republican President. The new Congress convenes January 3, 2027.

RaboResearch expects legislative gridlock. Democrats lack the two-thirds majority needed to override a veto (290 House seats, 67 Senate seats), and moderate Republicans face MAGA backlash if they defect. Only bipartisan proposals could pass, and there is very limited common ground.

Fiscal policy is likely to stall, with possible brinkmanship over government shutdowns and the debt limit in 2027. Gridlock should limit additional spending and tax cuts, but Rabobank does not expect a serious effort to control public debt, so the debt trajectory stays upward-sloping.

Markets had already priced in divided government, so the effect on longer-term rates was muted. The 10-year Treasury yield fell a few basis points overnight. Prediction markets gave a Blue Wave more than 60% odds and a Democratic House more than 90%.

A Democratic Senate can block Trump's appointments. For the Fed, this would stop Trump from installing loyalists on the Board of Governors if a current governor is forced out (Cook) or steps down voluntarily (Powell).

The House can open investigations and impeachment proceedings. Conviction needs a two-thirds Senate majority, so removal is unlikely. The investigations are likely to undermine cooperation between Trump and the Democratic majority.

Trump is likely to rule through executive powers and test their limits, especially on foreign, trade and immigration policy. The OBBBA stimulus stays in place because Trump can veto any attempt to overturn it.

The lame-duck Congress has about 24 legislative days left, and a December 11 deadline to avert a government shutdown will use some of that time. Republicans still have a window to push some priorities through.

The Iran conflict is unsettled and Trump's executive powers allow him to attack Iran again, which could bring another inflationary impulse as soon as November. RaboResearch raised its 2027 and 2028 energy price forecasts. Its US inflation forecast rises for 2027 and falls for 2028.
Higher 2027 inflation adds upside risk to Rabobank's call that the Fed stays on hold in 2027 after another hike next month.
Gridlock and Democratic state-level wins could hamper the AI boom, especially data center construction. This is a downside risk to business investment, growth and US competitiveness against China.

With domestic policy gridlocked, Trump is likely to focus on foreign and trade policy. Pending items include Section 301 investigations on global excess capacity and digital services taxes, and the supply chain and technology contest with China. All three also affect the EU. Existing tariffs likely stay as far as they survive in court and Trump vetoes Democratic legislation.

sector_views.rationale: Gridlock and Democratic state-level victories could hamper construction of new data centers, a downside risk to business investment and growth.

tension_points.bull_case: Gridlock limits additional government spending and tax cuts. OBBBA stimulus stays in place because Trump can veto any repeal.
tension_points.bear_case: Gridlock raises the risk of shutdown and debt limit brinkmanship in 2027. No serious effort to control public debt is expected, so the debt trajectory stays upward-sloping.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Bipartisan proposals backed by Trump, which would need restraint from Democrats on investigations.

theme_stances.key_argument: Democratic majorities cannot override vetoes, so legislation is likely to stall and Trump will rely on executive powers.
theme_stances.evidence: Therefore, we are likely to see gridlock in legislation.
